summary: Iteration 16: tested the Mock Interview API and UI end to end, the sample page-image viewer with the buy nudge, owner /book links, and the receipt email (code review plus a direct render with send_email mocked). Backend 8/8 pytest pass. Real Claude grading works and finishes in under 10s for 2 answers. Blank answers score 0, reference answers only appear after grading, 409 on double submit and on draft after submit, 404 for other users' sessions, 402 for non-owners. Frontend works except for one bug: the 'review' link in interview history does nothing when clicked inside the app. Loading ?view=id directly works.

minor.issue: No server-side expiry check. Drafts are accepted after expires_at, and a late submit is graded with the new answers (only timed_out=true is set). A user can bypass the 30-min limit with an API call. Suggest rejecting drafts after expiry plus a small grace period, and grading the last saved draft on a late submit.
Abandoned in_progress sessions never get closed or graded once they expire. History will show them as 'in_progress' forever.
asyncio.create_task(send_book_receipt(...)) keeps no reference to the task, so it can be garbage-collected before it finishes. routes_interview already uses a TASKS set for this; do the same here.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the review Link (/app/interview?view=id) from /app/interview changes the URL but keeps showing the intro. The ?view param is only read in a mount-only useEffect([]), and the component doesn't remount on a same-route search change. A direct page load of ?view=id does show the results. Fix: use useSearchParams() and depend on the view value, or call poll(id) in the link's onClick.

issues: The sticky sample-nudge is semi-transparent and covers the bottom of the page image. Acceptable, but a more opaque background would read better.
On page 10 the disabled Next button keeps its focus border, so it looks active.

action_items: Fix the interview history 'review' link inside the app. MockInterview.jsx line 112 reads window.location.search only on mount. Switch to useSearchParams and react to changes of 'view'.
Enforce the time limit on the server for draft and submit after expires_at (with a grace period).
Keep a strong reference to the send_book_receipt task in activate() (TASKS set).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_interview grade(): a single LLM call grades all answered questions. If the model returns malformed JSON, the session goes to status=error and the UI offers 'Retry marking'. That is good. Retry re-submits with {} but reuses the stored answers, which is correct.
Model string 'claude-sonnet-5-5' works with the Emergent key (verified live).

send_book_receipt: verified the HTML passes _assert_safe_email and contains the item, ₹973 amount, order id, provider (title-cased), date and a 'Read your ebook' https link to FRONTEND_URL/book. No real email was sent.
Session timer auto-submit and the 15s draft autosave rely on stale closures. They go through ansRef, which is fine.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 graded interview sessions for the demo student (plus 1 from the UI run) and fresh TEST users test_iv_*/test_ui_*@example.com. The demo student's test purchase row was left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist; tests in test_mock_interview_sample.py share module state). Registration requires a username field. New users land on /onboarding (onboarding-goal-interview-prep then onboarding-continue-button). Grading 2 answers takes about 5-10s.
